[P2] Fence condition-state serialization continuations

This fence ends when `check` settles. If the subsequent `serdes.serialize` remains pending past the deadline, releasing it still calls `serdes.deserialize` and then `config.waitStrategy` in the disposed invocation. The outer DurablePromise fence suppresses eventual settlement but does not prevent these callbacks; external-storage deserializers can therefore start fresh I/O after timeout and overlap a retry. Fence the serdes continuations and strategy dispatch with the owning lifecycle, leaving them suspended after closure. Add a regression that holds the post-check serializer across expiry and verifies that neither callback starts.
